svg.title: Stock Market Dashboard — Web App Tech Stack
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram for a Python-based web stock dashboard, from real-time data source through FastAPI backend, Redis, WebSocket, to React/Next.js frontend and PostgreSQL storage.

g.text: NSE / BSE live quotes · OHLCV · 52-wk high/low · volume · screener fields
REST API · WebSocket /ws/quotes · Watchlist CRUD · Alert / GTT endpoints · Auth (JWT)
Stores latest snapshot per symbol · channels subscribed by FastAPI WebSocket workers
Historical price fetch · GTT order checks · Alert evaluation · Market-open notifications

svg.text: Python backend · React frontend · Click any block to ask more
